item.title: €15m scheme awarded to support local journalism
item.description: MORE than €15million was awarded to publications, radio stations, and broadcasters nationwide, including the Limerick Post, to help support high-quality journalism. The funding was announced by Coimisiún na Meán (CNaM), Ireland’s independent media regulator.
